name: Eve Motion (EU)

radios.note: CSA lists Thread and Bluetooth; Eve's page lists Bluetooth Low Energy and Thread.

matter.note: CSA lists Eve Motion with Matter over Thread (vendor 0x130A, product 0x0059, firmware 3.2.1). Eve announced the Matter version in November 2022. The CSA pages are inconsistent on the product name, so the verifier should recheck which listing is the Motion sensor.

apple_home.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller). On Apple that means a HomePod mini, HomePod 2nd gen or Apple TV 4K.

google_home.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller).

alexa.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller).

smartthings.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller).

home_assistant.note: Reached through Home Assistant's Matter integration, which needs a Thread border router for Thread devices.

hubRequired.note: Eve says Matter devices need a hub with Matter controller and Thread border router functions. That is not an Eve bridge, so we leave it unconfirmed, as with Eve Energy.

localControl.note: No source we saw states local-only control for Eve Motion.

senses.note: Eve describes a motion sensor with an integrated light sensor (twilight setting 0 to 15,000 lux). Whether every Matter platform exposes the light reading is not confirmed.

power.note: Eve's spec lists two replaceable AAA cells; one press article says AA, which the spec contradicts.

summary: Eve Motion is a battery motion sensor with a built-in light sensor, and it can go indoors or outdoors with an IPX3 rating. It covers a 120 degree field of view out to about 9 m. The Matter version uses Thread, so Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant can add it, each through a Thread border router. It takes two AAA cells.
caveats: Needs a Thread border router; it does not join a network without one.
Older Eve Motion units are HomeKit-only and gain Matter after a firmware update; once updated they cannot go back to HomeKit.
Eve's page may show the product as unavailable in some regions; check the EU model before buying.
